description: This file contains test cases and mode definitions for JavaScript syntax highlighting in CodeMirror. It defines various test scenarios for highlighting different JavaScript syntax elements including functions, classes, imports, destructuring, async/await, typescript extensions, and JSON-LD syntax. The tests invoke the CodeMirror getMode function with different settings and provide labeled examples for syntax validation.
